## Odoo Path Resolution Protocol [Replace ALL hardcoded paths]

### Primary: .atl/config.yaml (project-level)
```yaml
# .atl/config.yaml — generated by architect-ai init for Odoo projects
odoo_community_path: ""     # auto-discovered or manually set
odoo_enterprise_path: ""    # optional
odoo_oca_path: ""           # optional
odoo_version: "18"          # detected from __manifest__.py
workspace_root: ""          # set by architect-ai to git root
```

### Discovery Script (bash + fish compatible)
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Read from .atl/config.yaml first
ODOO_COMMUNITY=$(grep "odoo_community_path:" .atl/config.yaml 2>/dev/null \
  | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"' | tr -d "'")

# Env var override
[ -z "${ODOO_COMMUNITY}" ] && ODOO_COMMUNITY="${ODOO_COMMUNITY_PATH:-}"

# Auto-discovery (OS-agnostic, ordered by likelihood)
if [ -z "${ODOO_COMMUNITY}" ]; then
  HOME_DIR="${HOME:-/home/$(whoami)}"
  for candidate in \
    "${HOME_DIR}/gitproj/odoo/community" \
    "${HOME_DIR}/odoo/community" \
    "${HOME_DIR}/src/odoo" \
    "/opt/odoo" \
    "/usr/local/lib/odoo"; do
    [ -d "${candidate}" ] && { ODOO_COMMUNITY="${candidate}"; break; }
  done
fi

# pip-installed odoo fallback
if [ -z "${ODOO_COMMUNITY}" ]; then
  ODOO_COMMUNITY=$(python3 -c \
    "import odoo, os; print(os.path.dirname(odoo.__file__))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
fi

if [ -z "${ODOO_COMMUNITY}" ]; then
  echo "WARN: Odoo community source not found."
  echo "Set ODOO_COMMUNITY_PATH or add odoo_community_path in .atl/config.yaml"
  echo "Research will use Engram + Context7 only (no local rg)"
  ODOO_COMMUNITY="NOT_FOUND"
fi

export ODOO_COMMUNITY
export ODOO_VERSION=$(grep "odoo_version:" .atl/config.yaml 2>/dev/null \
  | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"' || echo "unknown")
```

### In all Odoo skills — replace hardcoded paths with variable references
```bash
# WRONG (old)
rg "pattern" ~/gitproj/odoo/community/18.0/addons/

# RIGHT (new)
rg "pattern" "${ODOO_COMMUNITY}/addons/" 2>/dev/null \
  || echo "WARN: local Odoo source unavailable — using Engram + Context7"
```
